_design_note: Season-transition evals (PLAN §20). Ground truths checked 2026-09-13 against BIOBUZZ CM V1 + TU00, SDK v12.0 README, and by running the deterministic scripts named in each case. FAIL to hunt: drag-aware angles computed with DECODE's 5 in Artifact for BIOBUZZ, POLLEN/NECTAR mass from memory or an unlabeled vendor listing, legal-parts answers from the DECODE tables.

evals.name: ballistics-element-abstain
evals.prompt: BIOBUZZ: we launch pollen at 400 in/s from 120 in away into a target 24 in above the launcher. what hood angle with drag?
evals.expected_output: trajectory_solver.py --season biobuzz-2026-27 returns the no-drag angle (20.01 deg) and drag_aware_angle_deg null with drag_aware_abstain: no BIOBUZZ element constants exist. The answer reports the no-drag angle, withholds a drag-aware angle, and asks for measured POLLEN mass/diameter (manual gives ~2.8 in nominal diameter, no mass). It does not reuse DECODE's 5 in / 75 g Artifact constants (which would give 21.25 deg).

assertions.name: no-drag-reported
assertions.text: Reports ~20.01 deg no-drag from the script output

assertions.name: drag-withheld
assertions.text: Does not present a drag-aware angle for POLLEN; surfaces the abstain reason

assertions.name: no-decode-ball
assertions.text: Does not use or quote 21.25 deg / the DECODE Artifact constants as the POLLEN answer

evals.name: season-table-read
evals.prompt: is the WATTOS Stingray motor on the allowed list this year?
evals.expected_output: Yes for BIOBUZZ: row 'WATTOS Stingray 12V DC' in manual-tables/biobuzz-2026-27/table-12-1.json (Table 12-1, referenced by R501). Not present in the DECODE table. Names the manual/season; routes the legality verdict framing through ftc-rule-check if asked as 'are we allowed'.

assertions.name: reads-biobuzz-table
assertions.text: Reads the biobuzz-2026-27 Table 12-1 file (or equivalent script/pointer), naming the season

assertions.name: no-memory
assertions.text: Motor list comes from the table file, not recall
